mechanism: A downstream executive rejects uncertified strategic memos until the writer attaches audit proof.
failure_mode: Receiver lacks authority to reject unaudited work

mechanism: A buyer requires vendors to include verified reasoning proof before a proposal can be accepted.
Readers distrust incoming claims unless they carry a reasoning-attestation artifact.
A team keeps an audit trail proving that a consequential claim was checked before approval.
carrier: Audit trail attached to decision log
failure_mode: Audit record provides no perceived protection
